about_the_game:
You just won the "Galactic Getaway" lottery, and the grand prize is... a giant cantina-spaceship on the remote planet of Marimo! With the last of your credits, can you turn this rusty, debt-ridden hulk into the hottest spot on the cosmic frontier? Get ready to hunt on an exotic world by day and serve delicious, otherworldly dishes to a diverse clientele of aliens by night!

Ginga Cantina is a charming and humorous adventure that blends top-down hunting, deep management, and quirky storytelling.

  • RUN YOUR DREAM CANTINA: By night, it's your time to shine! Use the ingredients you've gathered to create a menu, serve hungry aliens, and manage your cantina. From equipment to holographic decor, upgrade every aspect of your establishment to boost your profits and reputation

  • EXPLORE THE PLANET MARIMO: By day, descend to the planet's surface to hunt strange creatures, forage for exotic plants, and scavenge valuable parts from old shipwrecks across 5 unique biomes. Master the casual combat and gathering loop, but be prepared for the unexpected dangers lurking on this vibrant world.

  • TEAM UP WITH A QUIRKY CREW: You're not alone in this venture! You'll be joined by Chef Maneki, a grumpy but wise cat-like chef who seems to be part of the ship's original furniture, and the mysterious Bishop, who handles all your upgrades from the workshop without ever showing their face. Your crew also includes Gorko, a cunning alien arms dealer, and Dr. Hopper, an insectoid scientist who has come to research the planet Marimo.

  • FEED THE "GASTRONOTS": Your clientele isn't just limited to regular customers. Appease colossal and picky planetary bosses, known as "Gastronots," not by fighting them, but by feeding them in special, engaging minigames to earn massive rewards and fame.

  • A COZY & HUMOROUS ADVENTURE: With its modern pixel art style, retro-inspired visuals, and a warm, lighthearted narrative full of witty dialogue, Ginga Cantina offers a casual, stress-free, and genuinely funny gameplay experience. From your first customers, the sly merchant Gorko and the eccentric scientist Dr. Hopper, every day brings a new story.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 Dual Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTS 450 / AMD Radeon HD 5570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 - i7 Quad Core
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTX 750Ti / AMD Radeon R9 270x
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 12 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device

short_description: Ginga Cantina is a casual sci-fi adventure RPG that blends top-down hunting and gathering with cantina management. Hunt exotic creatures on a vibrant alien planet by day, then cook and serve them to a quirky cast of cosmic customers by night to build the galaxy's most renowned cantina.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Traditional Chinese, Turkish
